pr_title: GameEngine: restore current main full-gate hygiene
pr_body:
## Summary

Restores current-main validation hygiene regressions discovered while validating the automation throughput PR.

- initializes native 2D test settings without Clippy's field-reassign-with-default warning
- keeps Remote AI Studio private-path sanitization coverage while using the scanner-approved explicit `...` Windows user placeholder
- initializes the model-import source-generation test settings in one struct literal to satisfy the same Clippy lint

These are test-only hygiene changes; runtime behavior, serialization, stable IDs, public APIs, and trust-boundary scanner rules are unchanged.
